title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - DataRate
description: http://qudt.org/vocab/quantitykind/DataRate. Represents data rate as a measurable quantity. Subclass of QuantityKind per the Gaia-X ontology, with no properties of its own beyond those inherited (applicableUnit, quantityValue); inherited properties are documented on the QuantityKind model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'DataRate'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
